hardware: Concept enclosure and display, not a photograph or confirmed specification
must_validate: Price and unit economics against comparable tablet deployment
Battery/runtime at selected display and rotation interval
Offline scanner validation, trusted time and eventual synchronisation
Screenshot replay and real-time remote relay threat model
Code sharing does not alone prove physical presence
Device-to-site/room binding and physical tamper handling
proof_needed: Real hardware clip of code rotation, actual app scan and offline-to-synced event with person/place/time. Do not substitute model QR codes for authenticated protocol proof.
visual_review: Browser permission denied. Separate raster design overview is a composed mockup, not a browser screenshot.
claim_boundary: A scan is a recorded event at an assigned point. Rotation does not prove continuous attendance or independently prevent a live relay.
